name: native-snapshot-source
goal: Run actual native acceptance from the selected Harness snapshot without borrowing live source or inventing revision identity

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Actual acceptance needs Git inventories, but clean Harness exports contain no Git metadata. Supply selected immutable objects and give native builds their own export.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard snapshot matrix covers drift and output bounds but not selected Git source inventory. Extend it with a cold real Git object read inside the exported check.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed failing selected-source inventory assertion at 1d07fecf3; native source objects are absent in the exported check.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: SnapshotRunService supplies immutable object location and exact object format; exports retain ordinary source and output isolation.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Sealed paired proof d89879b0 red and c1c8a14e green: unchanged snapshot inventory check passes at 0a03ef352 without checkout metadata or snapshot drift.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
